evidence: Added authenticated GET app/api/work-mode/assignments/route.ts in PR #8.
The endpoint explicitly scopes base reads to employment_assignments.user_id = authenticated user id.
Publication reads are limited to event ids present in the authenticated worker's assignment rows.
Existing app/api/work-mode/assignments/[id]/respond/route.ts remains unchanged and continues to own accept/decline.
hooks/use-work-mode.ts now consumes the server read model instead of directly aggregating authorization-sensitive Work tables in the browser.
The stale event_participants dependency is removed from the Work hook.
A second implementation PR (#11) was compared and closed as duplicate to preserve one canonical implementation path.
Added WorkModeAssignmentListItem, WorkModePublication, WorkModeAssignmentsPayload, and WorkModeApiResponse to types/hiring-roster-work-mode.ts.
Removed duplicate hook-local Work assignment/publication interfaces and preserved the existing external field shape through shared compatibility types.
The engineering constitution requires tests/evidence before expanding to the next coherent slice.

authorization_checks: Authenticated user is required at GET /api/work-mode/assignments.
Base assignment query is explicitly filtered by user_id before any Work context is assembled.
Publication event ids originate only from authorized assignment rows in this first slice.
Client sessionStorage/user_sessions selection remains a navigation/context hint and is not an authorization source.
No event_participants authorization assumption remains in hooks/use-work-mode.ts.
No legacy worker_shift_check_in/out RPC is introduced.

regressions.summary: The previous hook could synthesize publication-only pseudo assignments from participant/shift-derived event ids. The audited canonical model now requires employment assignment ownership, so this behavior is intentionally not preserved unless a later verified scope rule justifies it.
